articles.title: Taiwan Detects 7 Chinese Naval Vessels, 1 Official Ship Around Its Waters
articles.description: Taiwan's MND reported detection of 7 PLAN vessels and 1 official ship operating around Taiwan up until 6 a.m. UTC+8 on May 6, 2026. ROC Armed Forces monitored the situation and responded accordingly.

articles.title: Taiwan Detects 1 PLA Aircraft Sortie and 6 PLAN Vessels
articles.description: Taiwan's MND detected 1 PLA aircraft sortie, 6 PLAN vessels and 1 official ship operating around Taiwan on May 5, 2026. One sortie entered Taiwan's northern ADIZ.

articles.title: PLA Liaoning Carrier Transits Taiwan Strait
articles.description: Taiwan's MND detected China's Liaoning aircraft carrier transiting the Taiwan Strait on April 20, 2026, moving southward as part of broader PLA operations.

articles.title: Taiwan Air Force Monitors and Responds to PLA Activity
articles.description: Taiwan Air Force monitored PLA aircraft and naval operations around Taiwan in late April 2026 and deployed aircraft in response to detected military activity.

articles.title: PLA Southern Theater Command Conducts Exercises East of Luzon Strait
articles.description: PLA STC announced on April 24 a surface task group exercise including Type 055 and Type 052D destroyers east of Luzon Strait in response to current regional situation, likely referring to Balikatan 2026 exercises.

articles.title: PLA Liaoning Aircraft Carrier Transits Taiwan Strait Southward
articles.description: PLA's Liaoning aircraft carrier transited the Taiwan Strait heading south on April 20, 2026, as part of broader strategic operations signaling resolve ahead of diplomatic engagements.

articles.title: PLA Warns Japan After Strait Transit
articles.source: PLA Eastern Theater Command / Ministry of National Defense
articles.description: PLA denounced Japanese destroyer transit through Taiwan Strait on April 21, 2026, deploying naval and air assets to track and monitor the vessel throughout the process.
